_doc: Edge Discovery — SPINE x CRYPTO-MAJORS variant. Measures the full production decision spine (CRT/Gaussian/ZoneGate/RR -> Fusion -> RegimeGovernor -> Decision -> ExecutionPlanner -> UltronRiskGate) under the research truth standard, as the 'spine' hypothesis, across the four crypto majors. apply_signal_defaults MUST be false so the runner keeps the spine's own SL/TP geometry. Qualification knobs are identical to research_config_majors.json so spine verdicts are comparable to the toy family. The `spine` block is read by ProductionSpineSource (not by ResearchConfig).

spine._prod_version_note: Canonical, R1/R2-governed v2 (matches configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION after the 2026-06-11 truth-audit restoration) — NOT the experimental 'v2_multi_2026_04 - deepdeektry' string the older research_config_spine.json still pins. v4_multi_2026_06 is NOT loadable on the `patch` branch (requires pre-TP3-absent CRTConfig fields); to measure v4, check out the post-TP3 code line and set prod_version=v4_multi_2026_06.
spine._bitnet_shadow_note: Repointed to shadow config (use_bitnet=true) for the BitNet gate-ON arm of the F-050 shadow diagnostic. OFF arm = research_config_spine_majors.json.
